title: Index and search on HDFS log dataset

bodyText:
Hi,
just a quick question, is it possible to do a wild card search on a text field? I have a simple test data structure of people with firstname, lastname and address. Firstname is mostly only one word and I wanted to search on word fragments, like for example if I had a Willy in my data, I wanted to search for illy and find him.
Is this possible yet and if so, how?
Best regards
title: Wildcardsearch

bodyText:
I've noticed that tantivy holds a thread pool per IndexWriter so I suppose each indexing server will open NUMBER_OF_INDEXES * NUM_THREADS_PER_INDEX threads?
It sounds like a lot of threads to me, am I missing something?
Thanks a lot! :)
